solver_notes: Real two-thread C11 regression on physical aarch64. Each of 2000 rounds deterministically preempts a consumer after reading head A and next B; the peer pops A and B then recycles A ahead of C. Pointer-only CAS accepts the stale A/B snapshot in 2000/2000 rounds and corrupts the head to detached B. The fix atomically couples the pointer with a uint64_t epoch and increments that generation on every successful update: the same stale CAS is rejected 2000/2000 times, ABA success is zero, and the A->C chain remains intact. Ordered push/pop regression passes. GCC reports tagged_16B_always_lockfree=0 on this Cortex-A72 build, so this proves atomic ABA prevention but does not overclaim wait-free/lock-free 128-bit CAS performance on this ISA; libatomic is required. Static node storage deliberately avoids an allocator/UAF confound while exercising real pointer recycling. Scope is the stated lockless_queue.c invariant, not a claimed patch to upstream CPython.
